zoe_csm: Heads-up — client OpalStream onboarding: nightly p99 tail spiked to ~1.7s (typical ~0.42s). Renewal owner worried. Proposing targeted change: short chats (<=200 tokens) -> compact-int8 variant + prefix KV cache (ttl=30s), pin critical flows to baseline. OK to run canary?
owen_se: agree with targeted canary. Suggest 3% traffic for 3h during low-traffic window, auto-fallback to fp16 on quality gates.
jamal_sre: infra: current pool at 70% GPU. KV cache adds ~1.1GB/replica. We can reserve +2GB temporarily; will add OOM + mem alerts.
riley_dataops: quick eval (n=500): compact-int8 latency p95/p99 improved ~18%/~35%, quality delta ~0.9% on instruction set; a few edge prompts diverge. Will paste gist after canary.
luke_revops: renewal note: proactive ops plan + rollback rules = strong signal for renewal conversation. Please document.
deploy-bot: canary precheck OK (quota_pending=true). Canary will be created when owner triggers.
zoe_csm: Proposed gates: auto-rollback if p99 > baseline * 1.12 OR eval-match-drop > 1.5% OR critical-flow error-rate +0.4%. Also add explicit route override: `route.tags contains "billing" -> baseline`.
owen_se: I'll push canary at 02:30 UTC, id will be posted here. Owen to attach routing snippet and eval link.
deploy-bot: canary queued: opal-compact-int8-c-7465 weight=3% window=10800s owner=owen_se
zoe_csm: Thanks team — next steps: owen push, riley attach eval gist, jamal reserve mem + alert, luke update renewal playbook, notify client after results.
